PLAN "12-week Strength & Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase strength and improve body composition"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundational" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Upper Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
          wrist_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
